name: v192_compact_news_option_current
hypothesis: Compact fusion of three low-correlated ACTIVE parents: news18 chain staleness, long-tenor option/alltype stability, and current-accrual cleanliness. Each sleeve is deliberately simple to stay under BRAIN's 64-operator limit.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(global_novelty_chain_elapsed_ms) - vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 126), industry) + 0.33 * group_rank(ts_rank(((call_breakeven_720 - put_breakeven_720) - (call_breakeven_90 - put_breakeven_90)) / close, 90), industry) + 0.23 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * current_accrued_liabilities_total / assets, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Compressed replacement for over-limit v192 initial candidate. Strict-check against WjpJwMdP, Vkpeno3w, and A1wmZ22l.

name: v192_compact_option_current_book
hypothesis: Option/alltype convexity, current-accrual cleanliness, and actual book-value support had low pairwise correlations. This tests whether a three-parent balance can clear correlation without the news-chain sleeve.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.36 * group_rank(ts_rank(((call_breakeven_720 - put_breakeven_720) - (call_breakeven_90 - put_breakeven_90)) / close, 90), industry) + 0.27 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * current_accrued_liabilities_total / assets, 126), industry) + 0.27 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_bvps_value / close, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: No WjpJwMdP leg; intended to reduce news self-correlation while keeping three distinct data sources.

name: v192_compact_news_option_ebit
hypothesis: News-chain staleness and option/alltype convexity are low-correlated; EBIT actual-vs-estimate delivery adds a slow analyst/fundamental delivery leg without using BVPS or contract-liability fields.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(global_novelty_chain_elapsed_ms) - vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 126), industry) + 0.33 * group_rank(ts_rank(((call_breakeven_720 - put_breakeven_720) - (call_breakeven_90 - put_breakeven_90)) / close, 90), industry) + 0.23 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_ebit_value / assets, 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Designed to avoid direct BVPS/KPbZ0eLg and current-liability/A1wmZ22l dominance.

name: v192_compact_current_contract_option
hypothesis: Combines current-accrual cleanliness, contract-liability growth residual, and option/alltype convexity. It excludes receivable and gross-income guidance to reduce LLprjdP9 sibling risk.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * current_accrued_liabilities_total / assets, 126), industry) + 0.28 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_drc + fnd6_drlt, 252) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.28 * group_rank(ts_rank(((call_breakeven_720 - put_breakeven_720) - (call_breakeven_90 - put_breakeven_90)) / close, 90), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: A compact cross-parent blend; if it maps to LLprjdP9/A1wmZ22l, close this fusion branch.

name: v192_compact_book_residual_option_news
hypothesis: Actual BVPS minus analyst BVPS estimate may express realized book delivery rather than estimated book value. Option/alltype and news-chain sleeves are included as unrelated timing parents.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(anl4_fs_actuals_advanced_af_nd_bvps_value / close - anl4_fs_detail_estimates_advanced_af_nd_bvps_mean / close, 126), industry) + 0.33 * group_rank(ts_rank(((call_breakeven_720 - put_breakeven_720) - (call_breakeven_90 - put_breakeven_90)) / close, 90), industry) + 0.23 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(global_novelty_chain_elapsed_ms) - vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Explicit book residual; reject if it remains a wpR9AnYd/KPbZ0eLg sibling or loses strength.

name: v192_compact_current_flow_option_news

expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(current_accrued_liabilities_total / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.33 * group_rank(ts_rank(((call_breakeven_720 - put_breakeven_720) - (call_breakeven_90 - put_breakeven_90)) / close, 90), industry) + 0.23 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(global_novelty_chain_elapsed_ms) - vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 126), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
